paraphrase: Having bowed to Nārāyaṇa, full of all qualities and free of all defects, the purport of the Gītā is told. Of the śāstras the Bhārata is the essence; in it, the thousand names of Viṣṇu and Kṛṣṇa's Gītā; by knowing them one is readily freed.
speaker: Madhva
notes: checked against the Devanāgarī e-text in sources_raw/raw_etexts/vedAntam/dvaitam (github.com/sanskrit/raw_etexts); numbering follows that copy and may differ in other editions
